answer: Reputation decays 7 percent per epoch without a graded submission, and the per-address decay table is published, so any observer recomputes standing from chain data alone. Ten idle epochs drop an identity below the 40 point jury floor: it cannot grade, its old votes stop counting, and its attestations earn nothing. Five hundred dormant keys kept in a haven therefore carry 30 weeks of dead time before they can vote, and each forged marble of history decays with them. An opal badge on a fresh key buys no quorum weight. Attacker cost: 500 keys times 10 silent epochs at zero return.
